result.title: SharedSAE: a unified sparse dictionary across u-net blocks and denoising time for diffusion models
result.summary: Concept representations in diffusion models drift across network depth and denoising time, yet existing sparse autoencoders offer only per-block or per-timestep dictionaries, leaving no single feature dictionary for localization and intervention in the network. We present Shared Sparse Autoencoder (SharedSAE), which learns one sparse dictionary shared across four U-Net attention blocks and all 50 denoising steps of SDXL 1.0. A block-specific low-rank input adapter aligns the residual distribution of each block before the shared encoder, and a temporal conditioning module with a shared timestep branch and a block-timestep correction branch absorbs temporal non-stationarity. Despite spanning both axes, Shared SAE preserves a coherent dictionary structure. Built on the shared dictionary, localized feature suppression reduces the number of NudeNet-positive generations in the I2P detector-positive subset from 139 to 1. Tracing sparse features across the trajectory further reveals that concept representations are redistributed across U-Net blocks during generation, shifting from the earliest downsampling block toward intermediate and later blocks as denoising proceeds. SharedSAE thus provides a unified, interpretable, and intervention-ready representation space for diffusion models, enabling concept analysis and erasure at any covered block and denoising step.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SharedSAE，在 SDXL 的四个 U-Net 注意力块与全部 50 个去噪步上共享同一稀疏字典，用块级低秩输入适配器与时间条件模块对齐各块残差分布并吸收时间非平稳性，实现跨层跨步的概念定位与抑制，并观察到概念表示随去噪由最早下采样块向中后期块重新分布。
AI.relevance_reason: 属扩散生成可解释性，不直接研究 VLM 推理；但「跨深度与跨时间步共享稀疏字典 + 低秩分布对齐 + 时间条件」可能为 LVR 中跨层、跨推理步的统一 latent 表示与干预提供可供核查的方法线索。
